methods.label: Compare angle definitions
methods.explanation: An obtuse angle measures more than \(90^\circ\) and less than \(180^\circ\), while a right angle measures \(90^\circ\). Therefore, an obtuse angle is larger than a right angle, so the answer is A.
methods.levelReason: Uses the grade 4 definitions of obtuse and right angles directly.
